description: Internal master identifier of the factor, for example M001.
Sunday that closes the Monday-to-Sunday formation week. Signals, breakpoints and value weights are measured on this date.
The following Sunday. The factor return is earned from formation_date to return_date.

Weekly factor return as a decimal rounded to 4 dp (0.0125 = 1.25%). A blank cell means missing, not zero. MKT is in excess of the risk-free rate; all other factors are long-short spreads with no risk-free rate subtracted.
Sunday that closes the formation week (one row per week).
